summary: Fixed quick price update bug. The issue was that the frontend sends pricingSlabs and stockStatus to PATCH /api/seller/listings/{id}, but the ListingUpdate model in seller_products.py didn't include these fields. Added pricingSlabs and stockStatus to the model and implemented the handler to persist pricingTiers to the database. All 8 backend tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: There are two ListingUpdate models - one in server.py (for PUT /api/listings/{id}) and one in seller_products.py (for PATCH /api/seller/listings/{id}). The frontend uses the seller endpoint, so the fix was needed in seller_products.py.
seed_data_creation: None - No seller listings exist to test with real data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick price update fix applied to seller_products.py ListingUpdate model. Added pricingSlabs and stockStatus fields. The handler now converts pricingSlabs to pricingTiers format and stores in database. Frontend testing requires Firebase authentication. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_quick_price_update.py

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The ListingUpdate model in seller_products.py was missing pricingSlabs and stockStatus fields. The frontend sends these fields to PATCH /api/seller/listings/{id}, but they were being silently ignored because the Pydantic model didn't define them.
reproduction_steps: 3. Click Update Price on a listing
4. Enter new price and click Save
fix_applied: 1. Added pricingSlabs: Optional[List[PricingTier]] to ListingUpdate model in seller_products.py
2. Added stockStatus: Optional[Literal[...]] to ListingUpdate model
3. Added handler in update_listing endpoint to process pricingSlabs -> pricingTiers conversion
4. Handler also stores price history for audit trail and updates minPrice for search
